name: Presidents
overview: Scripture reveals that godly leadership is essential for the flourishing of a nation, as seen in Psalms 33:12 where blessing is promised to those whose God is the LORD. Proverbs 28:2 emphasizes that wise and understanding rulers prolong the stability of a land, while Isaiah 32:1 highlights that righteous reign and just rule are marks of godly princes. These truths call leaders and citizens alike to live by God's unchanging Word (Malachi 3:6) and to obey His commands sincerely, not merely professing faith without action (Luke 6:46).
